title: Cluster Aggregated GAN (CAG): A Cluster-Based Hybrid Model for Appliance Pattern Generation
abstract: arXiv:2512.22287v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Synthetic appliance data are essential for developing non-intrusive load monitoring algorithms and enabling privacy preserving energy research, yet the scarcity of labeled datasets remains a significant barrier. Recent GAN-based methods have demonstrated the feasibility of synthesizing load patterns, but most existing approaches treat all devices uniformly within a single model, neglecting the behavioral differences between intermittent and continuous appliances and resulting in unstable training and limited output fidelity. To address these limitations, we propose the Cluster Aggregated GAN framework, a hybrid generative approach that routes each appliance to a specialized branch based on its behavioral characteristics. translated_title: 聚类聚合生成对抗网络（CAG）：一种基于聚类的混合模型用于电器模式生成
translated_abstract: 合成电器数据对于开发非侵入式负载监测算法和实现隐私保护能源研究至关重要，然而标记数据集的稀缺性仍然是一个重大障碍。近期基于生成对抗网络（GAN）的方法已证明合成负载模式的可行性，但大多数现有方法在单一模型中统一处理所有设备，忽视了间歇性和持续性电器之间的行为差异，导致训练不稳定和输出保真度有限。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了聚类聚合生成对抗网络框架，这是一种混合生成方法，根据每个电器的行为特征将其路由到专门的子分支。对于间歇性电器，聚类模块对相似的激活模式进行分组，并为每个聚类分配专用生成器，确保常见和罕见运行模式都获得充分的建模。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于聚类的混合生成对抗网络框架，通过为间歇性和持续性电器分配专门分支并聚类相似模式，解决了现有生成方法训练不稳定和输出保真度低的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cluster-based hybrid GAN framework that assigns specialized branches for intermittent and continuous appliances and clusters similar patterns, addressing unstable training and limited output fidelity in existing generation methods.
